Criteria.TestCondition: There is no keyboard trap.
Criteria.TesterComment: This test is not finished yet: 2 questions about it are still open. Keyboard focus kept cycling between "View timeline" (button), "name" (textbox), "birth year" (spinbutton), "#radix-\:r0\: > div:nth-of-type(2) > div:nth-of-type(1) >..." (checkbox) and 23 more. A judgment question about it is still open, so we could not decide yet. To see it, load the page and press Tab 54 times. At one point keyboard focus got stuck on "OVERVIEW" (tab), but pressing Tab moves focus back out, so it is not a trap. The page seems to load more content as you scroll, and the recording could not show all of it; content after the feed was reached only by Shift+Tab from the end.

Criteria.TestCondition: A visible indication of focus is provided when focus is on the interface component.
DisabilityImpact: With Limited Language, Cognitive, and Learning Abilities
Criteria.TesterComment: Some elements don't show when they have keyboard focus, so keyboard users can lose track of where they are. We could not get a clear before-and-after view of "Scroll down" (button) (never in view), so a person needs to check whether it shows focus: load the page and press Tab 23 times. When "OVERVIEW" (tab) gets focus, nothing on or around it changes that we could see, so keyboard users can't tell focus is there. To see it, load the page and press Tab 24 times. If you can see a focus indicator we missed, tell your assistant. We could not get a clear before-and-after view of "OVERVIEW" (tabpanel) (images could not be compared (ValueError)), so a person needs to check whether it shows focus: load the page and press Tab 26 times. When "#radix-\:r3\:-content-0 > div > div > button" (button) gets focus, nothing on or around it changes that we could see, so keyboard users can't tell focus is there. To see it, load the page and press Tab 27 times. If you can see a focus indicator we missed, tell your assistant. We could not get a clear before-and-after view of "SCIENTIFIC BACKGROUND" (tab) (the next element covers it), so a person needs to check whether it shows focus: load the page and press Tab 24 times, then ArrowRight. We could not get a clear before-and-after view of "CREDITS" (tab) (images could not be compared (ValueError)), so a person needs to check whether it shows focus: load the page and press Tab 24 times, then ArrowRight 3 times. 24 other element(s) showed focus clearly.
